Evanston Rides! Adult Social Ride

Evanston, IL · Road · Social

Evanston Rides! Adult Social Ride is a road and social group ride in Evanston, IL. It rolls first Tuesday of the month at 5:30 pm from Fountain Square, downtown Evanston.

How we know

Downtown Evanston's 2026 Evanston Rides! page lists the Adult Social Ride for Tue Oct 6, 5:30 PM from Fountain Square (leisurely about 10 miles, fast about 20), the last of the May-October series (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

For visitors

Free, but register for the date you plan to ride. Helmet and a bike light required. It ends with an optional happy hour at Ridgeville Tavern. Parking: Sherman Plaza Self Park, a block from Fountain Square.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: two groups: leisurely (about 10 miles) and fast (about 20 miles). It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @downtownevanston the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Evanston Rides! Adult Social Ride group ride

A monthly after-work loop out of downtown Evanston, led by the Evanston Transit Alliance. It splits into a leisurely group and a fast group, then ends at Ridgeville Tavern.
